title: Finite étale equivalence and torsor lifting
statement: Let i:Y₀ → Y be a morphism of schemes [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] inducing an equivalence of finite étale categories [def-weil-pbc-finite-etale-category]. Let M be a finite abelian group, G its constant abelian sheaf on Y [def-weil-pbc-constant-sheaf], and G₀=i⁻¹G [def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Let τ send G-torsors [def-sc-gm-torsor] to G₀-torsors. Suppose for each T there is an isomorphism e_T from the set-sheaf inverse image of T.sheaf to (τT).sheaf, such that for every étale W over Y, g∈G(W), t∈T(W), one has e_T(η_T(g+ᵥt))=η_G(g)+ᵥe_T(η_T(t)) over W×_Y Y₀. Here η_T and η_G are the units of the respective set and abelian inverse-image/direct-image adjunctions. For every G₀-torsor R there is a G-torsor T such that τT is isomorphic to R. No connectedness, nonemptiness or surjectivity assumption on i is made.

proof.text: Identify the coefficient inverse image with the constant sheaf downstairs. Apply the geometric representation-and-lifting interface to this coefficient-transported torsor: obtain t₀ representing R₀ and its lifted scheme torsor t with an equivariant base-change isomorphism.
Use the equivariant representative comparison to get a sheaf isomorphism eR from the inverse image of t.toSheafTorsor to R satisfying the unit action equations.
Choose eT and its unit equation using hτ. Action uniqueness proves eT.symm followed by eR is equivariant. This is a torsor isomorphism from τ(t.toSheafTorsor) to R.

theorem finiteEtale_lifts_torsor_transport
    [(@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale : MorphismProperty Scheme.{u}).IsStableUnderBaseChange]
    {Y Y₀ : Scheme.{u}} (i : Y₀ ⟶ Y)
    (hFE : (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback (@IsFinite ⊓ @Etale) ⊤ i).IsEquivalence)
    (M : Type (u + 1)) [AddCommGroup M] [Finite M]
    (τ : Sheaf.Torsor
        ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M)) →
      Sheaf.Torsor ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj
        ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M))))
    (hτ : ∀ T : Sheaf.Torsor
        ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
          (AddCommGrpCat.of M)), ∃ eT : (Scheme.etaleSetPullback i).obj T.sheaf ≅ (τ T).sheaf,
      let G := (constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj
        (AddCommGrpCat.of M)
      (∀ (W : Y.Etale) (g : G.obj.obj (op W)) (t : T.sheaf.obj.obj (op W)),
      eT.hom.hom.app (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj W))
        (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
          (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (u + 1))
          (Y.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
          (Y₀.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app T.sheaf).hom.app (op W)
            (T.vadd (op W) g t)) =
      (τ T).vadd (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj W))
        (((Etale.upperStarLowerStarAdjunction AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).unit.app G).hom.app
          (op W) g)
        (eT.hom.hom.app (op ((MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i).obj W))
          (((Functor.sheafPullbackConstruction.sheafAdjunctionContinuous
            (MorphismProperty.Over.pullback @Etale ⊤ i) (Type (u + 1))
            (Y.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)
            (Y₀.smallGrothendieckTopology @Etale)).unit.app T.sheaf).hom.app (op W) t))))
    (R : Sheaf.Torsor ((upperStar AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1} i).obj
      ((constantSheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}).obj (AddCommGrpCat.of M)))) :
    ∃ T, τ T ≈ R
